descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
XFINIT is recruiting a Mid-Level Full Stack Developer to help build financial products for small businesses. You’ll work in a small engineering team, developing backend services and web interfaces in a regulated environment.
 What you’ll do
Develop features using .NET and React across onboarding, KYC, account servicing, payments, cards and credit
Build and maintain APIs and integrations with external systems
Write automated tests and help improve application reliability and monitoring
Investigate issues and contribute to practical, maintainable solutions
Collaborate with engineering, product, risk and operations colleagues
 What we’re looking for
3+ years of professional software development experience, with solid C#/.NET skills
2+ years building production web applications, with experience in JavaScript frameworks, component design, state management and responsive interfaces
Experience with SQL-based relational databases and REST APIs
Understanding of third-party integrations, including retries, error handling, idempotency and reconciliation
Experience with automated testing, Git and CI/CD pipelines
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure and containers
A collaborative approach, attention to quality and the ability to flag risks or ask for support when needed
Good English would be an advantage
 Nice to have
Experience in fintech, banking or payments
Familiarity with open banking, card processing or financial reconciliation
Exposure to security requirements, audit trails, DORA or GDPR
Experience with monitoring and observability tools
Ability to use AI development tools effectively and review their output carefully
Willingness to make small changes to mobile applications when needed
 What makes this role interesting
 You’ll contribute across the stack, work closely with a small team and help shape a financial product from an early stage. Your work will connect technical delivery with real operational and customer needs.
 Interested? Get in touch with XFINIT to learn more about the role.
